name: patrol
description: Patrol: retro pixel-art fighter-jet flying toy and ambient multiplayer sandbox

scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=shared && npm run test --workspace=server
